status: MODELED specification (no human-factors or bench data)

coding.radius: 8 mm (1 ring) at 0.1 g to 104 mm (13 rings) at >= 100 g, log scale
coding.pulse: half the beep rate: 6.3 Hz at 50 mm, 2.3 Hz at 300 mm
coding.multi: one blob per target, dark seam where blobs meet, pulses phase-staggered, one audio voice per slot (up to 3)

controls.power: recessed push button on top of the handle pod above the trigger (rf2_pod.py): hold 2 s on / off; its light ring shows green on, amber boost, red low battery
controls.trigger: hold: pinpoint boost, continuous (rf2_continuous.py: the limits are thermal); double-press: store signature
